findings.desc: In isogenic human iPSC-derived microglia, fibrillar Abeta strongly increased lipid droplet accumulation, and the effect was exacerbated by the APOE4 allele and absent in APOE-knockout microglia.
findings.quote: However, treatment of iMG with fibrillar Aβ (fAβ) led to a strong increase in LD accumulation which was exacerbated by the presence of the APOE4 AD-risk allele.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (greater lipid droplet accumulation in microglia, exacerbated by fibrillar Abeta)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived microglia from isogenic APOE3/3 and APOE4/4 lines, with APOE-knockout control, treated with fibrillar Abeta; LipidSpot neutral-lipid live-cell imaging

findings.desc: In human Alzheimer's disease brain, the ACSL1-positive lipid-droplet microglial state was most abundant in APOE4/4 patients, and neutral lipid (Oil Red O) burden in frontal cortex was highest in the AD APOE4/4 group.
findings.quote: Through single-nucleus RNA sequencing of brain tissue in Alzheimer's disease, we have identified a microglial state defined by the expression of the lipid droplet-associated enzyme ACSL1 with ACSL1-positive microglia being most abundant in patients with Alzheimer's disease having the APOE4/4 genotype.
findings.summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4) -> (more ACSL1-positive lipid-droplet microglia and higher neutral lipid burden in AD brain)
findings.exp_system: Postmortem human frontal cortex from control, AD APOE3/3 and AD APOE4/4 donors; single-nucleus RNA sequencing and Oil Red O neutral-lipid staining

findings.desc: Conditioned media from lipid-droplet-containing APOE4 microglia induced Tau phosphorylation and neurotoxicity in neurons, an APOE-dependent downstream dysfunction effect of the lipid-accumulated microglial state.
findings.quote: Additionally, conditioned media from lipid droplet-containing microglia lead to Tau phosphorylation and neurotoxicity in an APOE-dependent manner.
findings.summary: (lipid-droplet-accumulating APOE4 microglia) -> (secreted factors drive neuronal Tau phosphorylation and neurotoxicity)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived neurons exposed to conditioned media from lipid-droplet-high versus lipid-droplet-low APOE4/4 iPSC-microglia; pTau (AT8) and cleaved caspase-3 immunofluorescence

findings.desc: APOE4, but not APOE3, disrupted the lipidome of human iPSC-derived astrocytes, increasing fatty acid unsaturation and the number of intracellular lipid droplets per cell (LipidTox quantification).
findings.quote: These changes resulted in increased unsaturation of fatty acids and accumulation of intracellular lipid droplets both in yeast and in APOE4-expressing human iPSC-derived astrocytes.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more intracellular lipid droplets and more unsaturated fatty acids in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes (APOE3/APOE3 vs APOE4/APOE4); lipidomics and LipidTox lipid-droplet imaging

findings.desc: Supplementing the culture medium with choline, a phospholipid precursor, restored the APOE4-disrupted cellular lipidome to its basal state in human iPSC-derived astrocytes and in APOE4-expressing yeast.
findings.quote: We showed that supplementation of the culture medium with choline (a soluble phospholipid precursor) restored the cellular lipidome to its basal state in APOE4-expressing human iPSC-derived astrocytes and in yeast expressing human APOE4
findings.summary: (choline supplementation in APOE4 astrocytes) -> (lipidome restored to basal state)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived APOE4 astrocytes and yeast expressing human APOE4, with and without choline supplementation; lipidomics

findings.desc: CRISPR-isogenic APOE4 iPSC-derived microglia contained significantly more intracellular lipid droplets (BODIPY-stained neutral lipid stores) than APOE3 microglia.
findings.quote: Staining for intracellular neutral lipid stores known as lipid droplets with the fluorescent dye BODIPY reveals significantly greater lipid droplet content in APOE4 iMGLs in comparison to APOE3 iMGLs
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (greater intracellular lipid droplet content in microglia)
findings.exp_system: CRISPR-edited isogenic human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells (APOE3 vs APOE4); BODIPY neutral-lipid staining

findings.desc: APOE4 microglia showed downregulated lipid catabolic processes and CD36 expression and took up less fluorescent fatty acid (C12 BODIPY) than APOE3 microglia, indicating reduced lipid uptake/turnover capacity.
findings.quote: we observed decreased uptake of the green-fluorescent fatty-acid C 12 BODIPY (C12 BODIPY) by APOE4 iMGLs
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (decreased fatty acid uptake and lipid catabolism in microglia)
findings.exp_system: CRISPR-edited isogenic human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells (APOE3 vs APOE4); C12 BODIPY fatty-acid uptake assay and RNA sequencing

findings.desc: The APOE4 lipid-accumulated microglial state was weakly responsive to neuronal activity: APOE4 microglia showed blunted ATP-evoked calcium responses and disrupted synchronized neuronal ensemble activity.
findings.quote: Our results reveal that APOE4 induces a lipid-accumulated state that renders microglia weakly responsive to neuronal activity.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lipid-accumulated microglia weakly responsive to neuronal activity)
findings.exp_system: Isogenic iPSC-derived microglia co-cultured with forebrain spheroids; ATP/glutamate uncaging calcium imaging and neuronal ensemble activity recordings

findings.desc: In APOE4 astrocytes, free cholesterol accumulated inside lysosomes: filipin/TRITC-dextran colocalization (lysosomal cholesterol) was increased 3-fold versus APOE3 astrocytes, with reduced NPC1/NPC2 and LAMP1/2 lysosomal export machinery.
findings.quote: Filipin and TRITC-Dextran co-localization (yellow puncta), a measure of lysosomal cholesterol ( Majumdar et al., 2007 ), was significantly increased (3-fold, p<0.001) in APOE4 compared to APOE3 astrocytes, indicating that intracellular free cholesterol accumulates in lysosomes
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (3-fold more lysosomal cholesterol sequestration in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes from APOE4 versus APOE3 donors; filipin and TRITC-dextran colocalization imaging

findings.desc: APOE4 astrocytes had 20% more total cholesterol than APOE3 astrocytes, derived from the free cholesterol pool rather than cholesteryl esters, measured by GC-MS.
findings.quote: APOE4 astrocytes showed 20% increased total cholesterol, derived from a free cholesterol pool but not cholesteryl esters (CE) compared to APOE3 as measured by Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (20% more total (free) cholesterol in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes from APOE4 versus APOE3 donors; gas chromatography-mass spectrometry cholesterol quantification

findings.desc: Isogenic APOE4 iPSC-derived astrocytes accumulated more intracellular cholesterol than APOE3 astrocytes, shown by stronger filipin III staining and higher filipin fluorescence by flow cytometry; lipid metabolism was the most affected pathway in APOE4 astrocytes.
findings.quote: We observed stronger signals of fluorescent filipin III in APOE4 vs. APOE3 astrocytes
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (intracellular cholesterol accumulation in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes (APOE3 vs APOE4, including CRISPR-converted lines); filipin III cholesterol staining and flow cytometry

findings.desc: In isogenic iPSC-derived astrocytes, APOE4 reduced cholesterol efflux and biosynthesis while cholesterol localization in lysosomes was elevated, in a genotype-graded manner (E4 > E3 > E2).
findings.quote: Cholesterol efflux and biosynthesis were reduced in APOE4 iAstrocytes, while subcellular localization of cholesterol in lysosomes was elevated.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (reduced cholesterol efflux and elevated lysosomal cholesterol in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes (APOE2, APOE3, APOE4 and APOE-knockout); cholesterol efflux assays and subcellular cholesterol localization

findings.desc: Proteomic analysis showed genotype-dependent reductions of cholesterol and lipid metabolic and biosynthetic pathways in astrocytes, graded APOE4 > APOE3 > APOE2.
findings.quote: Mass-spectrometry-based proteomic analysis showed genotype-dependent reductions of cholesterol and lipid metabolic and biosynthetic pathways (reduction: APOE4 >E3 >E2).
findings.summary: (APOE2 -> APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (graded reduction of cholesterol/lipid metabolic pathways in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes (APOE2, APOE3, APOE4, APOE-knockout); mass-spectrometry proteomics

findings.desc: ApoE4 diminished neuron-to-astrocyte fatty acid transport: fatty acids sequestered in neuronal lipid droplets were exported and internalized by astrocytes less efficiently with ApoE4, impairing astrocyte clearance of neuronal lipids.
findings.quote: FAs in neuronal LDs are exported and internalized by astrocytes, with ApoE4 diminishing the transport efficiency.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (reduced neuron-to-astrocyte fatty acid transport)
findings.exp_system: Primary mouse hippocampal neuron-astrocyte co-cultures from APOE3 versus APOE4 targeted-replacement mice; fatty acid pulse-chase transfer assays

findings.desc: ApoE4 lowered fatty acid oxidation and caused lipid accumulation in astrocytes (increased lipid droplet volume) and in mouse hippocampus.
findings.quote: Further, ApoE4 lowers FA oxidation and leads to lipid accumulation in both astrocyte and the hippocampus.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower fatty acid oxidation and lipid droplet accumulation in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Primary astrocytes from APOE3 versus APOE4 targeted-replacement mice; lipid droplet imaging (Plin2) and fatty acid oxidation assays

findings.desc: Astrocytes expressing APOE4 accumulated significantly more, and smaller, lipid droplets than APOE3 astrocytes, with higher expression of the lipid droplet protein perilipin-2.
findings.quote: We found that astrocytes expressing E4 accumulate significantly more and smaller LDs compared to E3 astrocytes.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more, smaller lipid droplets accumulated in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Primary mouse astrocytes expressing human APOE3 versus APOE4; lipid droplet imaging and perilipin-2 expression

findings.desc: APOE4 astrocytes showed decreased uptake of palmitate and decreased oxidation of exogenously supplied oleate and palmitate, with accumulation of lipid-droplet-derived metabolites from incomplete fatty acid oxidation.
findings.quote: We then probed fatty acid (FA) metabolism and found E4 astrocytes to exhibit decreased uptake of palmitate, and decreased oxidation of exogenously supplied oleate and palmitate.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (decreased fatty acid uptake and oxidation in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Primary mouse astrocytes expressing human APOE3 versus APOE4; radiolabeled fatty acid uptake and oxidation assays, oxygen consumption rate

findings.desc: APOE4-expressing astrocytes formed a small number of large lipid droplets enriched in unsaturated triglyceride, resembling APOE depletion, indicating aberrant droplet morphology and composition.
findings.quote: Like APOE depletion, APOE4-expressing astrocytes form a small number of large LDs enriched in unsaturated triglyceride.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (fewer, larger lipid droplets enriched in unsaturated triglyceride in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Astrocytes expressing APOE3 versus APOE4 after fatty acid pulse; lipid droplet imaging and lipid composition analysis

findings.desc: Lipid droplets in APOE4 astrocytes showed impaired turnover and increased sensitivity to lipid peroxidation.
findings.quote: Additionally, the LDs in APOE4 cells exhibit impaired turnover and increased sensitivity to lipid peroxidation.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (impaired lipid droplet turnover and greater peroxidation sensitivity in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Astrocytes expressing APOE3 versus APOE4; lipid droplet pulse-chase turnover and lipid peroxidation sensitivity assays

findings.desc: Primary microglia from humanized APOE4 mice showed, relative to APOE3 microglia, increased endolysosomal mass and increased lipid and lipid droplet accumulation at baseline.
findings.quote: Relative to E3 microglia, E4 microglia exhibit altered morphology, increased endolysosomal mass, increased cytokine/chemokine production, and increased lipid and lipid droplet accumulation at baseline.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (increased endolysosomal mass and lipid droplet accumulation in microglia)
findings.exp_system: Primary microglia cultured from humanized APOE3 versus APOE4 targeted-replacement mice; BODIPY lipid staining and endolysosomal markers

findings.desc: The APOE4 microglial lipid phenotype was accompanied by integrated-stress-response activation (increased eIF2alpha phosphorylation and decreased translation), indicating cell stress.
findings.quote: These changes were accompanied by decreased translation and increased phosphorylation of eIF2ɑ and eIF2ɑ-kinases that participate in the integrated stress response, suggesting that E4 genotype leads to elevated levels of cellular stress in microglia relative to E3 genotype.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (integrated stress response activation in microglia)
findings.exp_system: Primary microglia from humanized APOE3 versus APOE4 mice; translation assays and eIF2alpha phosphorylation immunoblotting

findings.desc: Microglial APOE4 expression increased lipid droplet accumulation, observed in APOE4 human brains and in human pluripotent stem cell-derived microglia.
findings.quote: Finally, we observed a reduction in Lgals3-positive responsive microglia surrounding amyloid plaque and an increased accumulation of lipid droplets in APOE4 human brains and pluripotent stem cell-derived microglia.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (increased lipid droplet accumulation in microglia)
findings.exp_system: Conditional mouse models with microglia/CAM-specific human APOE3 or APOE4 expression, APOE4 human brain tissue, and human pluripotent stem cell-derived microglia; lipid droplet staining

findings.desc: Microglial apoE4 expression downregulated lysosomal pathways and impaired lipid metabolism, while promoting stress-related responses, in single-cell transcriptomic profiling.
findings.quote: In contrast, apoE4 expression down-regulates complement and lysosomal pathways, and promotes stress-related responses.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (downregulated lysosomal pathways in microglia)
findings.exp_system: Mouse microglia with cell-autonomous human APOE3 versus APOE4 expression; single-cell RNA sequencing

findings.desc: Upon cuprizone-induced demyelination, apoE4 targeted-replacement mice had a much higher percentage of lipid-droplet (Plin2-positive) microglia in corpus callosum (26%) than apoE3 (13%) or apoE2 (9%) mice, indicating excessive microglial lipid accumulation and less efficient clearance of lipid-rich myelin debris.
findings.quote: Importantly, we found that the percentage of Plin2 + microglia was much higher in apoE4 mice (26%) compared to apoE2 (9%) and apoE3 (13%) mice (Fig. 6 D).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more lipid-droplet-accumulating microglia after demyelination: 26% vs 13% Plin2-positive)
findings.exp_system: ApoE2, apoE3 and apoE4 targeted-replacement mice fed 0.2% cuprizone for 4 weeks; Plin2/Iba1 immunofluorescence in corpus callosum

findings.desc: In P301S tau transgenic mice, ApoE4 (versus ApoE3 or no ApoE) strongly promoted glial lipid accumulation, with perturbed cholesterol metabolism and lysosomal function.
findings.quote: We demonstrate that in P301S tau mice, ApoE4 strongly promotes glial lipid accumulation and perturbations in cholesterol metabolism and lysosomal function.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (glial lipid accumulation and lysosomal dysfunction in tauopathy brain)
findings.exp_system: P301S tau transgenic mice expressing human ApoE4, ApoE3 or no ApoE; glial lipidomics and immunostaining

findings.desc: The LXR agonist GW3965 markedly upregulated Abca1 (about 30-40-fold) and reduced lipid droplet accumulation in primary ApoE4 microglia in vitro, showing the accumulation is reversible by increasing lipid efflux.
findings.quote: LXR agonist GW3965 markedly upregulates Abca1 and reduces lipid droplet accumulation in vitro.
findings.summary: (LXR agonist GW3965 in APOE4 microglia) -> (increased Abca1 and reduced lipid droplet accumulation)
findings.exp_system: Primary microglia from ApoE4 mice treated with 5 uM GW3965 for 24 h; Abca1 expression and neutral lipid (BODIPY) staining

findings.desc: In human neurons, ApoE carrying polyunsaturated fatty acid cholesteryl esters produced an allelic series (ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2) of lipofuscinosis, a lysosomal lipid-peroxidation pathology, linking APOE4 lipid cargo delivery to lysosomal lipid accumulation in neurons.
findings.quote: In human neurons, addition of ApoE carrying polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFA)-CE revealed an allelic series (ApoE4>ApoE3>ApoE2) associated with lipofuscinosis, an age-related lysosomal pathology resulting from lipid peroxidation.
findings.summary: (APOE2 -> APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (graded increase in neuronal lysosomal lipofuscin accumulation)
findings.exp_system: Human neurons treated with lipidated ApoE2, ApoE3 or ApoE4 carrying PUFA-cholesteryl esters; lipofuscin imaging

findings.desc: Lipofuscin was elevated in APOE4 mouse brain and exacerbated by tau pathology, and intrahippocampal injection of PUFA-CE-loaded ApoE4 was sufficient to induce lipofuscinosis in wild-type mice.
findings.quote: Lipofuscin increased lysosomal accumulation of tau fibrils and was elevated in APOE4 mouse brain with exacerbation by tau pathology.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (elevated brain lipofuscin, worsened by tau pathology)
findings.exp_system: APOE targeted-replacement mouse brain with and without tau pathology; lipofuscin quantification, plus intrahippocampal PUFA-CE-lipApoE4 injection in wild-type mice

findings.desc: In chimeric human cerebral organoids, astrocytic APOE4 alone significantly promoted lipid droplet formation and cholesterol accumulation in neurons, with the maximum effect when neuronal APOE4 was also present, demonstrating non-cell-autonomous APOE4-driven neuronal lipid accumulation.
findings.quote: Then, it was found in chCOs that astrocytic APOE4 already significantly promoted lipid droplet formation and cholesterol accumulation in neurons while both astrocytic and neuronal APOE4 contributed to the maximum effect.
findings.summary: (astrocytic APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lipid droplet formation and cholesterol accumulation in neurons)
findings.exp_system: Chimeric human cerebral organoids combining APOE3 or APOE4 neurons and astrocytes in all genotype combinations; neuronal lipid droplet and cholesterol imaging

findings.desc: ApoE4 disrupted intracellular lipid homeostasis in microglia, and lipid accumulation and inflammatory reactions were accelerated in microglia from TRPV1-deficient ApoE4 mice.
findings.quote: Lipid accumulation and inflammatory reactions were accelerated in microglia isolated from TRPV1flox/flox; Cx3cr1cre-ApoE4 mice.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4, worsened by TRPV1 deficiency) -> (accelerated microglial lipid accumulation)
findings.exp_system: Microglia isolated from ApoE4 mice with and without microglial TRPV1 deletion (TRPV1 flox/flox; Cx3cr1-Cre); lipid accumulation and inflammatory readouts

findings.desc: Activating TRPV1 with capsaicin rescued ApoE4-induced lipid metabolic impairments and autophagy defects, reversing microglial immune dysfunction in ApoE4 mice.
findings.quote: We showed that metabolic boosting by treatment with the TRPV1 agonist capsaicin rescued lipid metabolic impairments in ApoE4 neurons and defects in autophagy caused by disruption of the AKT-mTOR pathway.
findings.summary: (TRPV1 activation by capsaicin in APOE4 cells) -> (rescued lipid metabolic impairment and autophagy defects)
findings.exp_system: ApoE4 neurons and microglia treated with the TRPV1 agonist capsaicin in vitro and ApoE4 mice in vivo; lipid metabolism and autophagy assays

findings.desc: In astrocytes, ApoE4 promoted greater ARF6 expression than ApoE3, trapping ABCA1 in late endosomes and impairing its recycling to the cell membrane, which lowered ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux activity - a direct test of the decreased lipid transport limb of the hypothesis, with an endolysosomal mechanism.
findings.quote: We found that ApoE4 promoted greater expression of ARF6 compared with ApoE3, trapping ABCA1 in late-endosomes and impairing its recycling to the cell membrane.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (ABCA1 trapped in late endosomes and lower ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux in astrocytes)
findings.exp_system: Astrocytes treated with ApoE3 versus ApoE4; ABCA1 endosomal trafficking/recycling and ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux assays (abstract only - full text not retrieved)

findings.desc: Human CSF from APOE epsilon4/epsilon4 carriers showed a lower ability to induce ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux activity, and a greater percentage of aggregated ApoE protein, than CSF from epsilon3/epsilon3 carriers.
findings.quote: Human CSF from APOE ε4/ε4 carriers showed a lower ability to induce ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux activity and greater percentage of aggregated ApoE protein compared with CSF from APOE ε3/ε3 carriers.
findings.summary: (APOE epsilon3/epsilon3 -> epsilon4/epsilon4 human CSF) -> (lower ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux activity)
findings.exp_system: Human CSF from APOE epsilon4/epsilon4 versus epsilon3/epsilon3 carriers applied to ABCA1-expressing cells; cholesterol efflux activity assay (abstract only - full text not retrieved)
